name: timed
description: Timed episodes for development and the tests, static.json with the fixed schedule of level drops. The schedule drops one component level by level from a first cycle drawn in first_drop, which ends at 30 so that a component with three recorded drops at interval 10 reaches its worst level by cycle 50 and a work order created then closes, after the longest lead time and repair downtime of the asset, before the horizon of 60 with one cycle left for finish. A seed gives the same hidden start as static.json.
